scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems about derivatives of an atomistic or cell energy, with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: The elastic constants are C_abcd = -d sigma_ab / d eps_cd of the compressive-positive catalog stress sigma = -(1/V) dE/d eps of one cell energy E(F), F = 1 + eps, so C = (1/V) d^2E / d eps_ab d eps_cd at the reference cell.

The major symmetry needs E twice continuously differentiable at the reference; both minor symmetries also need E invariant under rigid rotations and a stress-free reference. At a pre-stressed reference the minor symmetries fail by terms in the residual stress.
For relaxed-ion constants E(F) must already be minimized over the internal coordinates at each F. Finite-strain fits of stress differences are estimators of the derivative and are not verified.
